environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind a classic ELB with TCP passthrough on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. The Flask app runs directly via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database contains production user records including email addresses and internal role assignments.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP listener port 443 -> instance port 8080
